value.body: Military Engineer Services, under the Ministry of Defence, builds and maintains infrastructure for the Army, Navy, Air Force and other defence bodies — buildings, roads, airfields, water and power. It has a mix of Army engineer officers and civilian engineers and staff.

items.label: Civilian officer entry
items.note: Indian Defence Service of Engineers (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical) and MES Surveyor Cadre

items.label: Junior Engineer entry
items.note: MES JE (Civil) and JE (Electrical & Mechanical); Pay Level 6

items.label: Army officers
items.note: Join through Army technical entries and serve tenures in MES

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A B.E./B.Tech (or a diploma for JE posts, with experience for some) in civil, electrical or mechanical engineering. Civilian officers come through UPSC ESE; JEs through SSC JE; Army engineer officers through Army technical entries; MES also issues occasional direct recruitment drives for supervisory and draughtsman posts.

value.title: At a glance
items: Postings are all-India, including remote and border stations.
Work includes contract management and estimation as much as design.
ESE is highly competitive and has a technical prelims, mains and interview.
